Driftline can now open the fix for you.

Add fix-pr: true to the GitHub Action and you get one draft pull request that renames retiring model IDs, kept up to date until you merge. Lines a rename can't fix get a checklist with the provider's guide.
aidriftline.com/#pr

New on the blog: Fix retiring AI model IDs with one pull request
aidriftline.com/blog/fix-retiring-ai-models-in-one-pull-request/

89 AI model IDs retire in the next 90 days across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI, Groq, Cohere, DeepSeek, Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure.

Find the ones in your code, no install and no key:
npx -y @aidriftline/driftline .

A rename keeps the API call working. The answers can still change.

Driftline Pro runs your real prompts on the old and the new model and puts a verdict in the fix pull request: safe to merge, read first, or don't merge yet.
aidriftline.com/#drift

Retirement alerts for any AI model now go to Slack, Discord or any webhook, as well as email.

Open the model's page, paste the webhook link, and you get a post 30 days before, 7 days before and on the day.
aidriftline.com/models/
